name: po-o8
prompt:
In server/src/overview.rs, replace the body `todo!("unit o8")` of fn refresh_git with the real code. Keep its signature and doc comment exactly. Spec:
1. `s.host.watch(&user_id);` then queue a shell job on the computer: `crate::access::queue_job(&s.db, &machine_id, &user_id, &json!({ "tool": "shell", "cwd": folder, "command": "git remote get-url origin; git branch --show-current" }), None).await`; on Err return.
2. Poll until GIT_WAIT has passed: every 500 ms (tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500))) read `SELECT state, result FROM machine_jobs WHERE id = ?` as Option<(String, Option<String>)>. When state is "done": if parse_git(&result.unwrap_or_default()) gives Some((remote, branch)), store `json!({ "remote": remote, "branch": branch, "at": util::now() }).to_string()` with `UPDATE projects SET repo_git = ? WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?` (project_id, user_id), then return. When state is "failed" or "refused" return without storing.
3. After the loop (time is up) delete the job if it never ran: `DELETE FROM machine_jobs WHERE id = ? AND state = 'queued'`.
Ignore database errors (let _ = ...; use .ok().flatten() for the read). Use sqlx::query / sqlx::query_as on &s.db.
Change nothing else in the file; the other functions keep their todo!() until their own job.
